A {creature:Warlock} and some {creature:Hero|Heroes} guard their treasure in the caves beneath Edron. Go down through the {wiki:Hero Cave} to the {wiki:Temple of Xayepocax}, clear the room and open the chests behind the level 70 door to receive a {item:Vampire Shield} and a {item:Dragon Lance}. A box outside also gives a {item:Strange Symbol}, a {item:Black Pearl} and a {item:Mysterious Fetish}.
A warlock and some heroes guard their treasure in the caves beneath Edron.
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
Level 70 for the quest door (80+ recommended).
Lots of health and mana potions: the final room has many enemies at the same time
The numbers in brackets in the steps correspond to the numbers on the map in section 1.
In the final room, pull the monsters a few at a time: the {creature:Warlock} and the {creature:Hero|Heroes} are the most dangerous.
1. Going down through the Hero Cave

If you are not in Edron, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the port of **Edron**, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. From the port, head **north** to the entrance of the {wiki:Hero Cave}, north of the city.
Go to the {wiki:Hero Cave}, **north of Edron city** (point 1 on the map). At the entrance there are 3 {creature:Hunter|Hunters}. Go down the hole.
Map of the route: numbers 1 to 8 correspond to the guide's steps
Watch out for the {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, the {creature:Priestess|Priestesses} and other minor creatures. Go down the next hole (2).

Go **north** to another hole in that room (3) and go down. This room has a {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monk} and some {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Dark Magician|Dark Magicians} and {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}.
Going east and north to the hole (4)
Go **east** and then **north** to the next hole (4) and go down. This room has 3 {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and some {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings}.
Going down the hole in the middle of the room (5)
The hole is in the **middle of the room** (5). Go down. Here there is a {creature:Hero} and some minor creatures.
Go around to the main floor (6). Get ready to be surrounded by creatures: kill them.
Go **south** to the end and then **east**. At the next crossroads there are some {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaurs}. Take the **southern** path and go down the stairs (7).

You are in the {wiki:Temple of Xayepocax}. Here you face 3 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, 3 {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}, 3 {creature:Hunter|Hunters}, 2 {creature:Hero|Heroes}, 2 {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, 2 {creature:Witch|Witches}, 2 {creature:Dark Magician|Dark Magicians}, 2 {creature:Dark Apprentice|Dark Apprentices}, an {creature:Orc Shaman}, a {creature:Stalker} and a {creature:Warlock}. Kill them all.
The {creature:Warlock} is the strongest enemy in the room. Do not pull everything at once.
Before you go through the door, open the quest box that is **outside** the level 70 door (8). It contains a {item:Strange Symbol}, a {item:Black Pearl} and a {item:Mysterious Fetish}.
Opening the chests behind the door

Go to the back of the room, pass the **level 70** {item:Door of Expertise|quest door} and open the {item:Chest (Quest)|chests}: one has the {item:Vampire Shield} and the other the {item:Dragon Lance}.
After the level 70 door there is also a teleport, but it leads to the Demon Forge (you need level 100 to enter), not to the exit.

To leave, go back the **same way**: go up the temple stairs (7) and follow the map from section 1 in reverse, from 7 to 1. Use the {item:Rope} at each hole you came down through (5, 4, 3, 2 and the entrance one) until you leave the Hero Cave.
The temple monsters respawn quickly, and on the way back you pass the {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and the {creature:Hero} again.
Outside, go **south** to **Edron** city. To leave the island, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the harbour ({key:hi}, the city name, for example {key:thais}, and {key:yes}).
